lines.t: They speak as though they know You Visions spun from their own hearts They claim the words are Yours But their hearts have made their own way
They tell the wounded, “Peace is coming” They promise calm while the storm is near And call the darkness light again
They wear Your holy name with pride Beneath the robes and sacred language There is something they conceal inside
Where is the peace we were seeking? Where is the healing we cried for? We searched for peace and found only trouble Looked for mending and met more pain
We have wandered far from You We have followed after our own hearts Still we lift our eyes toward Heaven Still we call upon Your name
Do not leave us in darkness Do not let our hearts grow cold Remember mercy in Your judgment Bring us back into Your fold
Night after night the tears are falling For a people wounded deep A generation lost in blindness While the watchmen are sound asleep
We trusted voices we created We believed what pleased our ears We own the wrong that runs through our blood
There is no throne above Your throne There is no might like Your hand Remember the seat of Your glory Remember the promise You spoke
Can the carved things of the nations bring rain? Can the empty sky open on its own? Let our hearts become surrendered Let repentance be our cry
We have wandered far from You We have followed after our own hearts Still we lift our eyes toward Heaven Still we call upon Your name
Do not leave us in darkness Do not let our hearts grow cold We have turned away from You, this we confess — Do not cast us off for the sake of Your name

[Instrumental solo - Deep tribal drums begin to intensify, Low cello pulses beneath the rhythm, Deep violins rise slowly, Ancient male chants become stronger, Flute echoes through the atmosphere, Bass gradually enters]
Only You command the heavens Only You can send the rain Only You can heal the broken Only You can cleanse our stain
You alone are the One who made it all You alone can send what the dry land needs No empty word can save us No false vision will remain
We have wandered far from You But we still remember Your name Through the sorrow and the silence You alone remain the same
We will not run to idols We will not trust another voice You alone are the foundation You alone are the only choice
Only You command the heavens Only You can send the rain Only You can heal the broken Only You can cleanse our stain
You alone are the One who made it all You alone can send what the dry land needs No empty word can save us No false vision will remain
We have wandered far from You But we still remember Your name Through the sorrow and the silence You alone remain the same
We will not run to idols We will not trust another voice You alone are the foundation You alone are the only choice
Only You command the heavens Only You can send the rain Only You can heal the broken Only You can cleanse our stain
You alone are the One who made it all You alone can send what the dry land needs No empty word can save us No false vision will remain
We have wandered far from You But we still remember Your name Through the sorrow and the silence You alone remain the same
We will not run to idols We will not trust another voice You alone are the foundation You alone are the only choice
Though the night is long and the wound is deep
No other name… No other refuge… No other hope…
Only You…
(soft) Only You… We will wait…
